description: Before installing a dependency: does the npm or PyPI package exist, is the version published, deprecated or yanked, which known vulnerabilities (OSV.dev, with fix version) it and its latest carry. Catches invented names. A lockfile audits every package, transitive ones too, with the chain pulling each flaw in. Names and versions go to OSV.dev, npm, PyPI. FAIL = missing package/version or high/critical flaw.

lockfile.description: Or alone: package-lock.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, yarn.lock, uv.lock, poetry.lock or pinned requirements.

manifest.description: Or the text of a package.json or requirements.txt.

name: package_check
